# comment-pass

The orchestrator's comment pass — strip a plan branch's added comments, a Sonnet judge keeps the load-bearing few, a ledger the gates verify.

- Spec: `docs/features/comment-pass/spec.md`
- Contract: `docs/features/comment-pass/contract.md`

## Files

```
go: tools/commentpass/**
go: internal/commentpass/**
```

## Decisions

- `kb:adr/process-comment-pass-drop-reaches-tests-and-css` — The comment pass's drop also reaches unit tests, E2E specs and helpers, and stylesheets, so every stale-comment note has a route; strip is unchanged. (accepted, 2026-10-13; features: comment-pass) → `docs/adr/process-comment-pass-drop-reaches-tests-and-css.md`
- `kb:adr/process-comment-pass-edited-comment-judged-on-truth` — A comment the branch edited by at most half its lines is judged on truth alone, not on whether it guards; one rewritten by more is the branch's own. (accepted, 2026-10-13; features: comment-pass) → `docs/adr/process-comment-pass-edited-comment-judged-on-truth.md`
- `kb:adr/process-comment-pass-owns-code-comments` — A comment pass before the gates strips every added production comment, a Sonnet judge keeps the load-bearing few, and review files no finding on a comment. (accepted, 2026-10-06; features: comment-pass) → `docs/adr/process-comment-pass-owns-code-comments.md`
